jobs.job_description: Synchronizes agents with the Wazuh Manager and Velociraptor server.
Drains pending AI analyst palace lessons into MemPalace via NanoClaw /palace/lesson.
Forgets expired one-off AI analyst palace lessons via NanoClaw /palace/forget.
Refreshes the in-memory Wazuh ruleset cache so catalog and sidebar requests never load it.
Refreshes the Detections Catalog GitHub-backed caches (CoPilot Searches rules, MITRE matrix) off the request path.
Refreshes the sidebar InfluxDB health indicator so the sidebar never runs the Flux query itself.
Assembles the deployment-wide sidebar indicators so /status/sidebar reads them from memory.
Notifies internal routes when an alert's or case's SLA turns at risk or breaches, once per clock.
Prunes audit_log entries older than the configured retention window (AUDIT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS).
